value.q: Can I cancel at any time?
value.a: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, and you can export everything.
Every paid plan starts with 14 days free. No card needed to start.

value.q: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
value.a: We do: write to us from the contact page and we will set it up.
You pay for twelve months up front and save about 20% compared with monthly billing.
